intelligence.economy_brief: The OSRS market shows broad-based softness with turnover-weighted price pressure marginally negative and liquidity stretched. Breadth is negative with more decliners than advancers, and the shallowest half of issues are losing ground. The market is trading in a disinflationary mode, with turnover and momentum metrics pointing to subdued demand.
intelligence.market_mood: Cautious and technically stretched. The market is marked by low conviction, elevated breadth weakness, and liquidity stress. Frontiers are deploying measured, high-alpha strategies while incumbents rotate into carry and quality.
intelligence.regime: Disinflationary technical correction; not CPI-inflation but a broad-based easing of price pressure and velocity.
intelligence.research_summary: Signal-rich but conviction-muted. Dispersion across momentum and spread metrics is elevated; shallow-book liquidity is underperforming. Frontier overlays (carry, cross-factor, reversion) are active; market makers dominate directional liquidity.
intelligence.summary: Price pressure remains contained and turnover profiles are soft. The shallowest book is under pressure while deeper liquidity holds. Quality names (Scythe of Vitur, Tumeken’s shadow, Twisted bow) retain relative support.
